lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, with a slight decrease in inter-line distance on the anterior portion near the shoulder.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The three posterior-most line segments are abbreviated, terminating in the mid-flank region rather than extending to the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 8 distinct white spots is visible on the lateral haunch, located inferior to the primary vertical line field.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Four spots on the lower haunch align to form a semi-connected horizontal geometric line segment parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white horizontal bands (stockings) on the upper sections of the limbs and a white crescent-shaped patch on the lower throat area.
